title: Managed Backup: lifecycle fees
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines lifecycle fees.

## Tier basis

**Setup fee.** One-time fee for a newly activated holding; USD decimal.

**On-demand termination fee.** Fee for terminating an on-demand holding, excluding accrued usage and commitment liability; USD decimal.

**Resumption fee.** Fee for restoring a suspended holding; USD decimal.

| Contract tier | Setup fee | On-demand termination fee | Resumption fee |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, setup fee is 0.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, setup fee stays the same.
